description: Generic CRUD Templates - Basic document operations

find_by_key.query: FOR d IN @@collection FILTER d._key == @key RETURN UNSET(d, "_rev")
find_by_key.description: Find document by key (collection, key required)

upsert.query: UPSERT { _key: @key } INSERT MERGE(@doc, { created_at: DATE_ISO8601(DATE_NOW()) }) UPDATE MERGE(@doc, { updated_at: DATE_ISO8601(DATE_NOW()) }) IN @@collection RETURN NEW
upsert.description: Insert or update document by key (collection, key, doc required)
